ios.desc:
Take the hassle out of tracking your meals.

Saylo AI makes calorie counting and weight management effortless — just say what you ate. Whether you’re trying to lose weight, gain muscle, or maintain a healthy lifestyle, our voice-powered logging helps you stay consistent without the grind. 

Voice-First Logging
No more barcode scanning or endless typing — simply describe your meal, and we’ll break it down into calories, carbs, protein, and fats.

Smart Progress Tracking
Get clear visualizations of your calorie intake, weight changes, and trends that keep you motivated.

Personalized Goals
Set your target weight, goal pace, and exercise level — we’ll calculate your ideal daily intake and adjust as you go.

Built for Busy Lives
Log meals in seconds, not minutes. Perfect for anyone who wants to stay healthy without overthinking every bite.

Start your health journey today — with no friction, no fluff, and no calorie calculators needed.
